facts.raw_span: A woman in her 60s with a history of hypertension
sudden-onset chest pain
no history of any acute febrile illness
no family history of sudden cardiac death
tachycardic with a pulse of 120 beats/min
blood pressure was normal
White blood cell count: 14,300/µL
Serum calcium: within normal limits
High-sensitivity troponin I: 1.15 ng/mL
Brain-type natriuretic peptide: 1060.30 pg/mL
Initial ECG showed sinus tachycardia, PR-segment elevation in lead aVR, PR-segment depression in leads I, II, III, aVF, and V4 to V6
Contrast-enhanced abdominal CT: revealed an enhanced left-adrenal heterogeneous mass measuring 4.1 × 3.4 cm
